description: Corrected activation patching and component-level results. Bug fix: ALL projections now use hidden_states[best_layer] consistently (previously patched used best_layer+1).

component_patching.interpretation: Tool-call Layer-0 is negligible (noise). System Layer-0 attention is dominant (79%). Tool-call processing distributes across layers 12-24.

routing_divergence.metric: L1 distance between format-conditioned and direct attention patterns
routing_divergence.interpretation: Routing divergence exists at Layer 0 but does NOT causally produce the tool_call shift (patching confirms negligible causal effect).

bug_description: Original script used hidden_states[best_layer + 1] for patched projection while direction and baselines used hidden_states[best_layer]. This compared projections from different residual-stream depths. Fix: all projections consistently use hidden_states[best_layer].
